name: SitePatent API
description: Anonymous read-only JSON API for the SitePatent product discovery directory: categories with listing counts, latest approved listings, trending listings, site of the day, topic tags and tech stacks.
notes: Free GET endpoints with no key and no account, described by a public OpenAPI 3.1 file. SitePatent also runs a read-only remote MCP server (https://sitepatent.com/api/mcp, Streamable HTTP) whose tools search the human-reviewed listings, read full listing profiles and find alternatives to a product.
